records.head: 560b5b99a46eafe8494d8576c9316426a7d88bdf
records.message:
fix: keep setup pages above visible navigation buttons

Constrain the pager to the top of the visible navigation buttons instead of
letting its content extend behind them. Use a top barrier that ignores gone
buttons so the bound follows the Next, Previous and Skip visibility changes.

Related: #2170

records.head: 8344231de57790bbe83262cca7fb8adf0d99e829
records.message:
fix: constrain clipboard editor height above action buttons

Let the wrap-content editor respect its existing top and bottom constraints
when vertical space is limited. Keep the action row below the editor and
preserve the editor's existing internal scrolling and line limits.

Related: #2170
